row.title: Deploys are judged by what visitors see; the edge cache must not outlive a deploy (CACHE-FRESH-1)
row.body: On 2026-11-25 the site kept serving old /claims and /live for 30+ minutes after deploy while cache-busted fetches were new. HTML now revalidates in browsers, stays at most 60 s at the edge, names its build, and a post-deploy probe fails on stale cached pages.

title: Deploys are judged by what visitors see; the edge cache must not outlive a deploy (CACHE-FRESH-1)
